title: Build types, product flavours, signing, R8 and the app bundle

videos.script: Lesson one built a debug app. This lesson builds the one you would publish. {{types}} First the build types. Debug and release, and a suffix that lets both live on one phone. {{flavours}} Then two flavours. One for Google Play, one handed out as a file, with four variants out of the two. {{key}} Then a key of your own. The password goes into the environment and never into a file, and you will see the error a build gives without it. {{r8}} Then R8. Eleven point seven megabytes become under one, and the names inside become letters. {{bundle}} Then the bundle, which is what Google Play actually wants. {{signing}} Then why Google Play holds a second key, and why outside it your key is the app. {{console}} And last, the Play Console, which costs money before anything else.
